Many predicted Delta Force would quickly fail, but that did not happen. The shooter has become a hit.

Since its release, the game has remained in the top 50 best-selling projects on Steam thanks to microtransactions, as the project is free-to-play. It currently holds 33rd place. For comparison, Battlefield 6 is in 89th position by revenue.

The online player count is also impressive. After launching in December 2024, the project has only grown stronger. Delta Force's peak online count on Steam now reaches around 170 thousand players. Marathon has around 20 thousand, while Battlefield 6 has approximately 45 thousand.

The developers from Team Jade are actively supporting the game with updates. A new season, Echo, has already started in Delta Force, and ahead is a collaboration with Crystal Dynamics and the arrival of Lara Croft. The heroine of the Tomb Raider series with a bow will become available on April 30, 2026. A short teaser of the character has already been shown.
